hunt.justification: Regulated industries face significant legal and ethical consequences for data loss. Hunting across the entire attack lifecycle is necessary as single-surface rules are frequently bypassed by evolving tactics.

meta.name: Regulated Industry Ransomware and Exfiltration

related.reason: This hunt focuses on host-level ransomware, whereas phishing may lead directly to cloud credential theft.

meta.analysis: This hunt correlates proxy connections with the parent process context of a mail client and the downstream high-velocity file activity burst (100+ files). This provides the multi-surface context needed to confirm an active campaign that single-surface rules miss.

stages.name: Phishing for Initial Access
observables: Phishing links clicked in email clients

stages.name: Command and Control via Multi-hop Proxy
observables: High-frequency outbound traffic to VPS or ORB networks
DNS lookups for known proxy or onion domains

stages.name: Data Encrypted for Impact
observables: Rapid modification of file extensions to known ransomware suffixes
Creation of ransom note files such as README.txt or DECRYPT.txt
High volume of file rename and write activity in user directories
Process activity involving cryptographic APIs or ransomware executables

scenario.summary: Threat actors targeting the healthcare and finance sectors utilize phishing to obtain initial access before establishing command-and-control through multi-hop proxies. The campaign concludes with the deployment of ransomware that encrypts sensitive data to cause operational disruption and financial loss.

meta.rationale: Focus on servers and workstations within regulated VLANs (Finance, Medical). Use the scope_hosts parameter if specific server naming conventions are available.
meta.hypothesis: An adversary has gained initial access to a healthcare or financial host via a phishing campaign and is using multi-hop proxies to exfiltrate data or deploy ransomware.

blind_spots.risk: A host without an agent provides no telemetry, meaning an intrusion could progress entirely in a blind spot.

blind_spots.requires: Endpoint agents on all hosts in scope
blind_spots.remediation: Audit device inventory and ensure 100% agent coverage on all high-value assets.

blind_spots.remediation: Implement TLS inspection for outbound traffic to known VPS and ORB networks.

hunt.name: Regulated Industry Ransomware and Exfiltration
hunt.description: This hunt targets the primary threat lifecycle identified for regulated sectors like healthcare and finance. It focuses on identifying three critical pivots: the initial execution of shells or administrative tools from productivity applications, the subsequent masking of C2 traffic via multi-hop proxy chains (Tor/ORB networks), and the final impact phase marked by rapid file modification and ransom note creation. By correlating these signals, the hunt identifies intrusions that bypass traditional endpoint-only detection rules.

nodes.label: Suspicious Process Spawned from Entry Points

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, process_name, process_cmd_line, parent_process_name, time FROM hb_process_activity WHERE (instr(',' || '{{phishing_parent_names}}' || ',', ',' || REPLACE(LOWER(parent_process_name), RTRIM(LOWER(parent_process_name), REPLACE(LOWER(parent_process_name), '\', '')), '') || ',') > 0 OR instr(',' || '{{phishing_parent_names}}' || ',', ',' || LOWER(parent_process_name) || ',') > 0) AND (instr(',' || '{{phishing_child_names}}' || ',', ',' || REPLACE(LOWER(process_name), RTRIM(LOWER(process_name), REPLACE(LOWER(process_name), '\', '')), '') || ',') > 0 OR instr(',' || '{{phishing_child_names}}' || ',', ',' || LOWER(process_name) || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0)
config.description: Identify potential phishing success by finding shells or admin tools spawned from browsers or mail clients, extracting the filename from the path to ensure matches.
config.expected_signal: Execution of system interpreters (PowerShell, CMD) triggered directly by productivity software.

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, process_name, dst_endpoint_ip, dst_endpoint_port, time FROM hb_network_connection WHERE direction = 'outbound' AND instr(',' || '{{proxy_ports}}' || ',', ',' || CAST(dst_endpoint_port AS TEXT) || ',') > 0 AND LOWER(process_name) NOT LIKE '%\chrome.exe' AND LOWER(process_name) NOT LIKE '%\msedge.exe' AND LOWER(process_name) NOT LIKE '%\firefox.exe' AND LOWER(process_name) NOT LIKE '%\svchost.exe' AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0)
config.description: Identify connections to common proxy ports, filtering out legitimate browser noise.
config.expected_signal: Connections to ports like 9050 or 9150 (Tor) from non-standard processes.

nodes.label: Rare Proxy and Onion Domain Lookups

config.content: SELECT query_hostname, process_name, COUNT(DISTINCT device_hostname) as host_count, MIN(time) as first_seen FROM hb_dns_activity WHERE (instr(',' || '{{proxy_domain_suffixes}}' || ',', ',' || LOWER(SUBSTR(query_hostname, instr(query_hostname, '.'))) || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) GROUP BY query_hostname, process_name HAVING host_count <= 2
config.description: Identify potential C2 through DNS activity for known onion suffixes or rare external domains.
config.expected_signal: DNS requests for multi-hop proxy suffixes or rare domains seen on very few hosts.

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, process_name, COUNT(*) as activity_count, MIN(time) as start_time, MAX(time) as end_time FROM hb_file_activity WHERE activity_id IN (1, 3, 5) AND (instr(LOWER(file_name), 'readme') > 0 OR instr(LOWER(file_name), 'decrypt') > 0 OR (instr(file_name, '.') > 0 AND instr(',' || '{{ransom_extensions}}' || ',', ',' || LOWER(SUBSTR(file_name, instr(file_name, '.'))) || ',') > 0)) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) GROUP BY device_hostname, process_name HAVING activity_count >= 100
config.description: Detect the final impact stage by identifying rapid file creation or rename activity exceeding normal OS thresholds.
config.expected_signal: Rapid bursts of at least 100 file modifications with encrypted suffixes or note creation from a single process.
